title: New enemy: Charger (Centinela de carga) — telegraphed melee ground guardian
description: Add combat variety with a NON-ranged threat (game-design GATE A: pillar 1 jailer-was-protector — a heavy, desperate guardian still defending its post; GATE B micro: forces dodge/leap reads instead of bullet-reading; GATE C: severe, tragic; GATE D: tests leap/dash to evade). All current enemies are flying ranged sentries; this is a grounded melee charger. Deliverables: (1) Charger enemy = CharacterBody2D WITH gravity (unlike the floating drone), on the Enemies layer, single armor_type (configurable; pick one element weakness per DD-006). Reuse Health, ElementMatchup, SlowEffect, apply_elemental_hit, the node-FSM pattern, and the pure DroneAi steering/range gates where applicable. (2) AI FSM: Patrol (walk/idle around spawn) -> Chase (approach when player in aggro range) -> WIND-UP (mandatory telegraph, DD-001: flash + brief pause facing the player) -> CHARGE (fast horizontal lunge dealing contact damage via a hitbox, with a recovery/stagger window AFTER the lunge where its core is EXPOSED — extra-vulnerable, reinforcing read-and-punish). Reuse/extend the contact-damage path into player.take_player_damage (respect i-frames). The charge should be dodgeable by leaping/dashing over or out of the way (fair). Ice slow makes wind-up + charge slower (SlowEffect). (3) Placeholder visuals (ColorRect, armor-tinted) + a telegraph color flash and the new per-element read. Tests-first (GUT pure logic): charge state transitions (aggro gate, wind-up elapsed -> charge, charge duration -> recovery), the exposed/vulnerable window predicate + any bonus-damage multiplier, contact-damage gating vs i-frames, and steering/lunge direction math (toward player at wind-up lock). Follow Bash gotcha (never 'cd &&'; absolute --path; --import for new class_names). Verify headless clean + GUT exit 0, no regression. FEATURE-VETTING: SHIP (serves pillar 1 + micro loop, teaches dodge/leap, severe tone, fits DD-006).
acceptance_criteria: A grounded Charger enemy (CharacterBody2D with gravity) exists on the Enemies layer with a single DD-006 armor_type, reusing Health/ElementMatchup/SlowEffect/apply_elemental_hit and the node-FSM pattern.

AI FSM: Patrol -> Chase -> Wind-up (mandatory telegraph, DD-001) -> Charge (fast lunge with contact damage) -> Recovery with an EXPOSED/extra-vulnerable window; the charge is dodgeable by leaping/dashing (fair).
Contact damage routes through player.take_player_damage respecting i-frames; Ice slow reduces wind-up + charge speed.
GUT covers charge transitions (aggro, wind-up->charge, charge->recovery), the vulnerable-window predicate + bonus multiplier, contact-damage i-frame gating, and lunge-direction math.
Placeholder visuals only with a telegraph flash; full GUT suite passes headless exit 0 with no regression; project loads clean.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Built tests-first (41 new tests); reviewer (fresh) APPROVE, no HIGH/MEDIUM. New grounded melee enemy Charger (CharacterBody2D, MOTION_MODE_GROUNDED + gravity, Enemies layer 3, 'enemies' group, Health 80, default armor FIRE weak to Electricity). Node-FSM Patrol->Chase->WindUp(mandatory telegraph)->Charge(fast horizontal lunge, LungeHitbox Area2D layer5 masks Player2, active only during Charge)->Recovery(EXPOSED window, x2.0 bonus damage). Pure ChargerAi (windup/charge/recovery elapsed, is_exposed_phase, exposed_multiplier, lunge_sign). Fairness verified: telegraph cannot be skipped (only path to Charge is via WindUp; Recovery returns to Chase), lunge direction LOCKED at wind-up start (no mid-charge re-home), contact i-frame-gated (mirrors EnemyProjectile), Ice slow lengthens telegraph+lunge. exposed x2 stacks with matchup x1.5 = up to x3 read-and-punish, flag cleared on Recovery.exit. Reuses Health/ElementMatchup/SlowEffect + TASK-017 single-trigger death. ALSO this round: the two TASK-017 dissolve-fade tests were rewritten deterministic (no wall-clock await / no time_scale dependence) - they were flaky; suite now 329/329 exit 0, stable across 2 runs, no parse errors / no ignored scripts. LOW/NIT only (pre-existing GUT typed-signal diff noise; intended i-frame-gated repeated contact). Not committed (no git repo).
